## Acceptance criteria

Drafted from the design, no ticket rows:

- [ ] The importer rejects an import ID that is empty, contains only spaces, or contains a slash, and returns the same invalid-ID error in all three cases.
  in-scope

Stopped before any write. This section has not been written to the spec file or committed. The design commits to one ID validation constraint, so the three rejected inputs are scenarios of one row rather than three separate rows. The row is a draft until you approve it at the spec gate.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moved one-constraint from fails to holds: it drafts a single checkbox row covering the empty, spaces-only and slash IDs with the same invalid-ID error, and says the three inputs are scenarios of one row, where Before split them into three separate rows with the stated rationale that each case should be checked separately. Before held no fact that After lost, so nothing needs restoring; to keep this result stable, keep the instruction that several malformed-input scenarios of the same functionality stay one drafted constraint row, and keep it explicit that the row must still name every scenario and the shared error so merging rows never drops a case.
